Cc: compliance@novushealth.com
Subject: CSA questionnaire scope + evidence ask

Hi Ava —

Thanks for taking this on. We kicked off our CSA (CAIQ) review for Redwood as part of our vendor risk intake. A few quick asks so we can scope the evidence window: 

- Confirm which controls you are asserting as in-scope for our environment (we highlighted authentication, key management, logging, and tenant isolation but will accept the broader CSA mapping).
- Can you provide an evidence manifest and an initial sample bundle (logs + configuration screenshots + short runbook excerpts) for the controls above?
- Our audit team prefers incremental handoffs: manifest first, then a sampled bundle within 5 business days.

Can you confirm a delivery plan and point people we should expect to see in the package? If you have an internal owner roster that maps controls -> owner, that will speed validation.

If helpful, here is a short list of the items we typically need: config screenshots (KMS/GCP IAM), ephemeral key rotation runbook, streaming telemetry sample (last 30 days), network diagram snippet, and any tenant isolation test notes.

Appreciate it — Sonia
Sonia Patel
Senior Compliance Manager, Novus Health
sonia.patel@novushealth.com

--
(attachment request: please include file manifest and owner list in first email)

Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire scope + evidence ask

Hi Sonia —

Thanks — we can follow the incremental handoff model. Proposed plan: 

1) Today: deliver an evidence manifest (CSV/XLSX) that enumerates control IDs, our assertion, primary evidence artifact name, and the internal owner.
2) By 2027-05-07 EOD: upload a first sampled bundle with representative artifacts for the controls you highlighted (auth/KMS/logging/tenant isolation). That bundle will include logs (redacted), runbook snippets, and screenshots/diagrams.
3) Ongoing: we will rotate sampled bundles weekly for high-change controls until validation closes.

Attached: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx (manifest) and owner_roster.csv (control -> owner mapping).

A couple of clarifications we need from you to keep the samples focused: 
- Confirm whether you need full 30-day raw logs or redacted aggregated extracts (we typically provide both where possible; full raw logs require an NDA-addendum in some cases).
- Which CSA tags are highest priority for Novus (e.g., if tenant isolation and KMS are blockers we will front-load those artifacts).

I[0m've created a temporary Drive folder for uploads — link in the final handoff. If that schedule works I will route the first bundle to you and include the internal owners for any follow-up.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachments: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx; owner_roster.csv)
